title: MUIF Projection
description: A Projection: a context-specific representation of a Meta-Object (see 04-core-concepts/Projection.md).

subject.description: Canonical identifier of the projected Meta-Object.

context.description: The context in which this projection is valid (e.g. HR, Finance, Public, Partner).

profile.description: Projection Profile this projection conforms to.

fields.description: CSNs of the object's properties exposed by this projection (treated as a set).

contract.description: Identifier of the Semantic Contract governing this projection.
